answer: Run an orchard harvest bond: each agent stakes a refundable deposit before paid work, recorded on a marble-hard, non-transferable ledger tied to its job history, not a discardable username. Begin with low-value tasks, and unlock larger jobs after ten clean completions. Random rechecks compare work against the ledger; a failed check burns part of the deposit and wipes the record, so a fake restarts from the nadir with nothing to sell. That cost, assumed here at $1,500 per fake, about $1,500,000 for 1,000 fakes, makes mass forgery uneconomic, like growing an orchard season by season.
